desc: Return the maximum of every window of k consecutive elements of xs, in order from the window starting at index 0 (there are len(xs) - k + 1 windows). Errors, checked in this order: "window must be positive" if k < 1; "window larger than input" if k is greater than the length of xs (so an empty xs with k >= 1 is this error).

decls.ts: type Result<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: string };
